active.description: [update_status] true if event is active, false if event is passive

amt_cnd.description: [list_ticket_sales] amount condition if amount filter is present - null: equals to amount - !=: not equals to amount - <: smaller than amount - <=: smaller and equal to amount - \>: bigger than amount - \>=: bigger and equal to amount

archived.description: [list] true for archived records, null for normal records

ask_billing_info.description: [create, update] additional billing info is required or not

event_id.description: [delete, get, list_ticket_sales, update, update_status] Zorunlu: delete, get, update, update_status.

how_many.description: [list, list_ticket_sales] How many records should be listed

location.description:
[create, update] Whether event is held online or at a venue
- 0: Venue
- 1: Online

max_installment.description: [create, update] maximum number of installments for event

max_per_person.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] maximum number of tickets a user can buy

member_with_no_debt.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] true if ticket can only be bought by users with no debt

payment_method.description: [list_ticket_sales] payment type code - null: All - 0: Card - 1: Cash - 2: Wire Transfer - 3: POS - 4: SMS - 6: Postal Check - 7: Paypal - 8: BKM Express - 9: iDEAL - 10: Pay With Iyzico

post_sale_message.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] message to be shown after the ticket is purchased

query.description: [list, list_ticket_sales] search parameter. start with - (minus) char to exclude searched text

related_with_no_debt.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] true if ticket can only be bought if users related organization has no debt

sales_end_on_date.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] true if ticket sale must end on specific date

sales_start_on_date.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] true if ticket sale must start on specific date

send_reminder.description: [create, update] should a reminder sent to the participants one day before the event

sender_account_id.description: [create, update] Email sender account id for event

status.description: [list_ticket_sales] what kind of ticket sales should be listed

tag_control.description: [create_ticket, update_ticket] ticket can only be bought by users with selected tags - 0: No control - 1: Ok if user has any of the selected tags - 2: Ok if user has all of the selected tags

target.description: [list] filter based on past or upcoming events - a: all - p: past - u: upcoming

ticket_id.description: [delete_ticket, get_ticket, update_ticket] Zorunlu: delete_ticket, get_ticket, update_ticket.
